# Cyber Kings - Sci-Fi Culture Appearances (generated by _dev/scripts/race_looks/gen_all.py; do not hand-edit)
# Appended to vanilla on_actions (merged lists). Birth race is genetic: set once, never changed by culture conversion.
on_game_start = {
	on_actions = { ck_race_on_game_start }
}
ck_race_on_game_start = {
	effect = {
		every_living_character = { ck_race_stamp_from_culture_effect = yes }
	}
}

on_birth_child = {
	on_actions = { ck_race_on_birth }
}
ck_race_on_birth = {
	effect = { ck_race_stamp_birth_effect = yes }
}

# Characters the game creates without a birth (pool, guests, court populator, new rulers, ruler designer...)
on_character_created = {
	on_actions = { ck_race_on_created }
}
ck_race_on_created = {
	effect = { ck_race_stamp_from_culture_effect = yes }
}

# Safety net: anyone still unstamped (a save started before the submod was enabled) is stamped from culture
random_yearly_everyone_pulse = {
	on_actions = { ck_race_on_pulse }
}
ck_race_on_pulse = {
	effect = {
		ck_race_stamp_from_culture_effect = yes
		ck_race_fill_dims_effect = yes		# characters stamped by an older version get any new look dimension
	}
}
